subject: Request: temporary launch-week headroom and blended overage rate
messages:
From: Ethan Rogers <ethan@launch-co.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: LaunchCo Ops <ops@launch-co.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short-term quota increase for launch week

Hi Laura —

We have a hard launch planned for next Monday (05/24) for a marketing campaign that will spike inference traffic. Based on our dry runs we expect ~3x our current daily token usage for a 5-day window. Can Redwood provide a temporary headroom increase (tokens/day) for 5–7 days and a short-term overage rate we can commit to?

Key asks:
- +200k tokens/day (temporary) starting 05/24 for 7 days
- A blended/discounted overage rate vs standard list; we need budget clarity by EOD Friday
- Minimal contract churn — prefer a short amendment/PO rather than a full contract restart

I can share our traffic schedule and expected windows (attached). Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Ethan
VP Product, LaunchCo
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Rogers <ethan@launch-co.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term quota increase for launch week

Ethan —

Thanks for the heads up and for the schedule. We can support a temporary uplift with the following proposal so you have something concrete for finance:

Proposal (temporary 7-day uplift):
- Provision +200,000 tokens/day for 2027-05-24 through 2027-05-30 (inclusive)
- Blended overage rate for uplifted capacity: 0.65x of standard overage list rate for uplifted tokens (applies only to the extra 200k/day)
- Cap: maximum incremental charge for the 7-day window $18,000 (after which we pause uplift)
- Billing: we will invoice as a short-term amendment line item on your next invoice; true-up applied after the window
- Minimal paperwork: short amendment (Doc attached) + PO ok; no full-term re-sign required

I've looped in Aditya for implementation and Markus for sign-off on the cap/invoice path, and Irene for support/operational runbook. I attached a draft amendment and the traffic CSV you shared.

If that looks good I can mark this as approved and kick off the implementation; if you prefer a lower cap or different blended multiplier we can iterate quickly.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T12:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: short-term quota increase for launch week — need quick OK

Team — forwarding LaunchCo request. TL;DR: +200k/day for 7 days starting 05/24, blended uplift at 0.65x list, cap $18k. Customer wants a minimalist amendment + PO today. Can Finance OK the cap & billing path? Can Ops/Support stand up the temporary quota and add the simple runbook (cache whitelist, prescriptive batching) so we minimize SLA impact?

Attachments: AMENDMENT_SHORT_TERM_BURST.docx, launch-traffic-schedule.csv, MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx

Thanks — we need a reply before EOD to lock terms.

—Laura
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short-term quota increase for launch week — need quick OK

Laura/Aditya —

Finance is comfortable with the proposed structure with two small edits:
1) Reduce the cap to $15,000 and add a contingency clause that any usage above the cap will be paused unless LaunchCo explicitly authorizes continued consumption (we can auto-notify after 85% of cap).
2) We will invoice the amendment as a one-time line item on the next monthly invoice; any realized consumption below the cap will be credited at the blended uplift rate.

Operationally this is low risk if Support implements the batching/runbook notes Laura mentioned. From a billing perspective we need a PO referencing amendment ID AMND-2027-0522 or a signed DocuSign.

-Markus
CFO (interim), Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Rogers <ethan@launch-co.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-23T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term quota increase for launch week

Ethan —

Thanks for your patience. We can confirm the following final terms (agreed by Finance & Ops):

Final terms (short-term headroom):
- +200,000 tokens/day from 2027-05-24 through 2027-05-30
- Blended uplift rate: 0.65x of standard overage list rate for uplifted tokens
- Cap: $15,000 total incremental for the window; usage beyond the cap will be paused and LaunchCo will receive an auto-notification at 85% and 100% unless you explicitly authorize continuation
- Billing: one-time amendment line item on your next invoice; any realized usage below the cap billed at blended uplift rate, with true-up crediting if actual is under the provisional estimate
- Paperwork: please sign the short amendment via DocuSign (link below) or send a PO referencing AMND-2027-0522.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/0A1B2C3D
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DEAL-2027-0059

Support notes (Irene): we'll prep a short runbook (cache whitelist, burst batching hints) and pause policy for the uplift window; implementation will be completed by EOD 05/23.

If that matches your expectation please sign and we'll activate the uplift on 05/24 at 06:00 PDT.

Best,
